notes: PlusTech's CUSTOMIZE (original scene 26: setup 0x0302f3, the icons 0x0324bd, the list 0x03215c drawn by 0x0303d7, the level meter 0x031d63 drawn by 0x02f3fc, the question 0x031ae2, notices 0x031821). Opened from the PlusTech menu (data/ui/plustech.json), which EXIT goes back to.

left/right move along the icons without wrapping (sys 3); confirm lists the player's parts of the icon's kind by name (0x0182b1), or says none; cancel jumps to EXIT (sys 4). In the list up/down choose, X and Y sort by name and price (sys 5), cancel goes back (sys 8) and confirm opens the meter.

The meter chooses a level from levels[0] to levels[1] (left/right): below 0 LIGHT, 0 NORMAL, above 0 HEAVY. The price (0x02f37e) is the difference between the part's prices at the two levels, or, crossing level 0, the way down to level 0 and back up from it; red when the money will not do. confirm on a new level: poor, or the tune question (NO chosen); YES pays (sys 27) and sets the level. A fitted body left with fewer socket holes than its hangar's modules take has them all taken off (dismantled). cancel puts the level back.

The stats panel shows the part at the level chosen; a part fitted in a hangar also shows the robot's TOTAL WEIGHT and its legs' WEIGHT CAPACITY with it (0x02f20f, 0x0baf8e). An arm or backpack weapon fitted shows which of the pair of slots holds it (0x017152): side_marks[0] for the hangar's first slot of the pair, [1] for the second.
The part's 3D model the original turns in the details window (0x030228) is not drawn. The cancel hint's gap after the B button is the researcher's reading of 0x06ded3's last argument (0x13).

icons.help: Go back to PlusTech top menu.

meter.help: Left/right: change level (hold to accelerate). D-pad + stick: double speed. LB/RB: -10/+10. LT/RT: minimum/maximum. Click or drag the meter; A/START confirms.

arm: A Holy type arm weapon by Il Ventuno. Handgun module. It fires 12.7mm ammo repeatedly. This basic Scoobee gear cooperates with a Chip’s aiming system to modify targeting. Not much power, but ensures stable manipulation.

A Holy type arm weapon by Il Ventuno. Machinegun module. Fires short rounds of 10mm machinegun ammo. Targeting modification possible with aiming system. Low power, but able to fire a barrage of ammo that will hit the target regardless of aiming systems.

A Holy type arm weapon by Il Ventuno. Shotgun module. Fires Anti-SV 15 gauge  shotgun shells. Targeting modification possible with aiming system. The power of each shell is small, but it is possible to hit a close target with multiple shells, increasing hit percentage.

A Holy type arm weapon by Il Ventuno. Bazooka module. Fires rockets from a 82mm launcher. Targeting modification possible with aiming system. The missile is slow, but causes a blast effect, so one can expect indirect damage as well.

A Holy type arm weapon by Il Ventuno. Gatling gun module. Fires high-speed 20mm Gatling shells. Targeting modification possible with aiming system. May burden the load capacity with its weight, but excels in both power and speed compared to a machinegun.

A Holy type arm weapon by Il Ventuno. Laser module. Emits asteady laser beam by pulling down on the trigger. Targeting modification possible with aiming system. Deals huge damage to an opponent by continuous contact. Cannot be used again after a recharge or when the trigger is separated.
A Holy type arm weapon by Il Ventuno. Drill module. Damages an opponent’s armor with a high-speed drill. When in ’double lock-on’, it follows the target to attack.

A Holy type arm weapon by Il Ventuno. Bunker module. Fire stakes from a linear motor on the shoulder and impales. As the stakes are impaled, the frontal attack area in increased. When in a ’double lock-on’, it follows the target.
A Holy type arm weapon by Il Ventuno. Blade arm module. Activates a high frequency vibroblade on the front shoulder to inflict much damage.

A Photon type arm weapon by Kojima Heavy Industries. Drill module. A.k.a Dragon Slayer. Damages an opponent’s armor with a high-speed drill. When in ’double lock-on’, it follows the target to attack.

shoulder: A Holy type shoulder weapon by Il Ventuno. Grenade launcher module. Fires grenades from a cartridge inside the module. The fired grenade flies in an arc, and explodes in a blast to damage the target. It can also be used in many ways, such as disabling Optic Camouflage with the blast effect, etc.
A Holy type shoulder weapon by Il Ventuno. Cannon module. Fires repeated 47mm shells. Targeting modification possible with the aiming system of a Chip.

A Holy type shoulder weapon by Il Ventuno. Missile launcher module. Fires a heat-seeking missile. By targeting with the lock-on system, the Chip automatically activates the lock-on, and the fired missile follows the target with its built-in system.

A Holy type shoulder weapon by Il Ventuno. Triple missile module. Fires 3 heat-seeking missiles. By targeting with the lock-on system, the Chip automatically activates the lock-on, and the fired missile follows the target with its built-in system. If one can patiently designate the lock-on for all 3 missiles, then they will all follow the target automatically.

A Holy type shoulder weapon by Il Ventuno. 4-way missile module. Fires 4 heat-seeking missiles. By targeting with the lock-on system, the Chip automatically activates the lock-on, and the fired missile follows the target with its built-in system. If one can patiently designate the lock-on for all 4 missiles, then they will all follow the target automatically.

A Holy type shoulder weapon by Il Ventuno. Missile burst module. Fires  heat-seeking missiles. The number of fired missiles can be customized.
